notes: Number boxes: tap one and the old number is selected, so typing replaces it. No more deleting first.
Sign in: Show / Hide for your password, and the keyboard's Next and Go keys move you through the form.
The AI is called “Coach” everywhere now. It used to be “Assistant” in some places and “coach” in others.
Sports and cardio that came from your watch are marked with a small ⌚.
The new Last time button glows the first time you see it, so you know it is there.
iPhone app: the clock and battery at the top now match the app's theme, and the old Siri weigh-in shortcut (a web-version workaround) is hidden.
